company.name: Veehive.ai
company.shortDescription: Dubai AI Seal certified enterprise agentic workforce platform. Deploys AI agents for customer ops, content, projects, and campaigns.
company.description:
Veehive.ai is a Dubai AI Seal Tier E certified enterprise agentic workforce platform built for organizations in the Middle East and beyond. Operating as Veehive Tech FZ-LLC from In5 Tech at Dubai Internet City, Veehive deploys a coordinated team of specialized AI agents across five core business functions.

Product Suite:
- mpliphi: AI customer-operations agent handling conversations on WhatsApp and email autonomously, supporting 50,000+ conversations/month in 50+ languages
- Veehive Studio: Document-to-video AI content production — turns PDFs and briefs into branded avatar videos in ~90 seconds, available in 30+ languages
- SnapaPro: Three-agent AI project management system (Taj, Noor, Sats) for task planning, team engagement, and time tracking
- HiveLink: AI-powered branded video community and distribution platform with white-label and on-premise options
- Veehive Mind: A 9-agent campaign execution hive (Mira) that runs multi-channel marketing campaigns end-to-end from a single brief

Veehive also operates VeehiveLabs (veehivelabs.com), a custom AI development studio that builds bespoke AI systems for banks, travel companies, and governments — including chatbots, document processing, computer vision, and agentic platforms.

Security & Compliance: SOC 2 Type II controls implemented, ISO 27001 aligned, GDPR-ready. Data never trains third-party models.

Recognized across 8 countries with 11 awards and accelerator programs. Partners include NVIDIA Inception, AWS Startups, Google Cloud for Startups, Microsoft for Startups, and Lenovo AI Innovators.
